The climate in Dimitrovgrad

Dimitrovgrad is about 110 m above sea level. The warmest month is August, with an average high of 33°C; the coldest is January, when nights average −2°C. Around 660 mm of precipitation falls in a year on average, most of it in June (about 76 mm). The highest temperature in Dimitrovgrad in 2015–2024 was 42°C (26 July 2023) and the lowest −16°C (1 March 2018).

Dimitrovgrad lies on the Maritsa river in the eastern Upper Thracian Plain and is one of the hottest places in Bulgaria: its summer highs are among the highest in the country. Winters are fairly mild, but fog and cold, damp air often linger in the plain. Spring comes early, and autumn is long and warm.

Best time to visit Dimitrovgrad

The most pleasant weather in Dimitrovgrad is usually in May, September and October: average highs are between 20°C and 28°C, with up to 11 days of rain a month. In July and August it is hot, over 30°C in the afternoon on average.
